content.thinking: The guide's page is dark and hard to read, and it lists savings and investment options. I see deposits under where the money is held, and I'll scroll down to check the lower section next.

The boxes under the short-term money heading were cut off, so I could only read the ends, and I'll sort the rest from what's visible. The grandchildren's child-savings plan is funded by National Insurance, not by you, so I'm moving on.
המשך מעבר על הקופסאות: מזומן שקלי, קרן כספית, מק"מ ואגרות חוב ממשלתיות נראות לי בטוחות יחסית, ומדדי המניות באנגלית אדלג עליהם.

content.text:
More "מדד", meaning shares again, ת"א-35, ת"א-125. The בורסה. Not for me.
At the bottom: "אתר אישי, לא מסחרי, בלי קישורי שיווק". So it's someone's private site, not a bank, not the government. "מקור"? Never heard of it. At least it doesn't want anything from me.
I didn't see a single number. Not how much a deposit gives, not how much מק"מ gives. Nothing about what the bank takes from me. No עמלה.
Enough.

**What I'd tell my son:**

"Listen, I haven't decided anything, and I'm not moving a shekel. It's a list explaining what each kind of saving is, and that's all. It didn't tell me whether anything gives more than my deposits, and it didn't say a word about what the bank takes from me. Two things caught my eye: מק"מ, which it says is 'a short loan to the State, up to a year, that בנק ישראל sells to the public', and government bonds, 'the State returns the amount on the set date'. Those sound as safe as a deposit. I want to ask you, or the clerk, how much they give compared to my deposit. There's also a 'קרן כספית' that says 'low risk', but it's a קרן נאמנות, and you remember what happened to me with one of those.

What I looked at: the opening 'מדריך' with 'איפה הכסף מוחזק' and 'במה הכסף מושקע'. Then the boxes: tax benefit, retirement (we already have a pension), 'for children'. 'חיסכון לכל ילד', for the grandchildren, is the money from ביטוח לאומי. Then 'מזומן שקלי', 'קרן כספית', 'מק"מ', 'אגרות חוב ממשלתיות'. All the 'מדד' boxes with the English letters, MSCI, S&P, נאסד"ק, I skipped. That's shares.

What I didn't understand: 'יומית' and 'מתחדשת' on the קרן כספית box, 'חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו', 'קרן שעוקבת אחריו', 'מדד' as shares and not prices. Also, the boxes under 'כסף שוטף וקצר' were cut off when I scrolled down, so I only saw the ends and not the names. One was probably the deposit.

What bothered me: the whole page is black with grey letters, hard on the eyes even with my glasses, and the small line at the top was too pale. There are no numbers at all, no interest and no fees. At the bottom it says 'אתר אישי, לא מסחרי', so I don't know who wrote it. It's not the bank and not the government. By the end, with all the shares boxes, I got tired and stopped."

The page itself shows no interest rates and nothing about bank fees.
